evidence.locator: Physical PDF page 1; original numbered procedure / conditional branch / table and its printed headers
evidence.quote: What is the Problem? The subject tires were marked as having a maximum permissible inflation pressure of 340 kPa, although the tires were designed and engineered as having a maximum inflation pressure of 350 kPa for which the tires comply with regulatory requirements. Accordingly, these tires do not comply with FMVSS 139, S5.5(c), which requires that the tires be marked with the maximum permissible inflation pressure for this tire. As a consequence of this unintended reduction of the labeled maximum inflation pressure, the tires fall subject to a different strength test prescription under FMVSS 109/139, which these tires were not meant to satisfy. The tires meet all applicable minimum performance requirements and other labeling requirements for tires with a maximum permissible inflation pressure of 350 kPa. Plant ID Size Code Optional Code Four-Digit Date Code (WWYY) In this example, for “0519,” 05 = two-digit week number; 19 = two- digit year) Be sure you are looking at the side of the tire with a 12-digit DOT.
